notes.notes:
■ Version: 0.3.5

Hi Bammers!

This update includes zombie AI improvement and several fixed issues.

When you throw a gingerbread, close zombies would follow it for now, since their detection range is decreased.

notes.title: Summer Update Sneak Peek - Part 3.
notes.notes:
Hi Bammers,

As you all know, Steam is going to have an annual summer sale soon.

We are going to give a discount per copy, but that's not all we will be offering. To celebrate this event, we will also introduce you three new features and these are going to make the game play even more exciting!

So from this week, we are going to reveal each of these in our announcement every Friday, PST. This is our second week of the Sneak Peek.

   Week 1 (June 1) : Introducing New Zombies (Link)
Week 2 (June 8) : Introducing New Weapons - Part 1 (Link)
 >   Week 3 (June 15): Introducing New Weapons - Part 2
   Week 4 (June 22): Update will be available!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New Weapons are coming! Part 2.

A lot of you guys have proposed that it would be great to see more weapons available in the game. Continue from the last week's sneak peek, we are happy to announce that there will be four(4) new range weapons available!

You can get these new weapons from Conveyor belt locates in a Cotton Candy Museum. This means you will not be able to upgrade them, but we devs have a plan to make them upgradable sometime in the future.

This week, we are introducing you two additional new weapons.
※ If you want to see the first two weapons, see last Friday's announcement.

3. M.O.T
It's basically a nail gun.. with a special attribute; try shoot it at a close distance and see how powerful it becomes compare to shoot at a ranged disctance. The better you handle this gun, more chances your co-op mate would say "You've nailed it!"

4. BaZooKa
Why not 'bazooka' and 'BaZooKa'? Find out why on this coming update! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's it for this week!
Leave us a feedback on comment or to our discord. We devs are ready to chat with you!



TEAM BAAM SQUAD.

notes.title: Summer Update Sneak Peek - Part 1.
notes.notes:
Hi Bammers,

As you all know, Steam is going to have an annual summer sale soon.

We are going to give a discount per copy, but that's not all we will be offering. To celebrate this event, we will also introduce you three new features and these are going to make the game play even more exciting!

So from this week, we are going to reveal each of these in our announcement every Friday, PST. This is our first week of the Sneak Peek.

> Week 1 (June 1) : Introducing New Zombies
   Week 2 (June 8) : Introducing New Weapons - Part 1
   Week 3 (June 15): Introducing New Weapons - Part 2
   Week 4 (June 22): Update will be available!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Attention! Zombies are approaching..!

We've received tons of requests from the community that there should be new zombies added in the game. And since we do care about the community and their opinions, we decided to add three new zombies who are strong and fast enough to make you feel challenging.


1. The Spider (Type A)
The Spiders were once the workers in the quarantine sector of this sweets factory. Their yellow coveralls is the most evident proof of where they are from. Since turning into zombies, they started to crawl like a baby, but somehow they became much faster with it. The Spiders will appear from Round 25.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32286916/7488f989e0c1ca620eccd8ad0944d40e7d2fdc08.png


2. The Spider (Type B)
These type B spiders are wearing an orange colored coverall, and was once the manager of the quarantine sector. They too are crawling but this time, they rather want to flip over their body like the one from exorcist. Also appear from Round 25.


3. The Freezers
The freezers are cold, cynical and quicker than they look. If you listen to their grotesque laughter, you will immediately think that you are really in danger of being.. freezed. Just like a Clown zombie, they will approach and explode around you. The Freezers will appear from Round 20.


Oh, and did you know that Bulky zombies have grown up their size? We did this to make you aware of that these Bulkies are a little slower, but have much more HP.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32286916/d35b5f0a99764b35372dc62adfd262438ddfc803.png

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Anyway, that's it for this week!
Leave us a feedback on comment or to our discord. We devs are ready to chat with you!



TEAM BAAM SQUAD.

notes.title: Summer Update is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi Bammers!

We would like to share you what has happened during our first month of debut and also about the upcoming summer update :)

1. What has happend during our first month?
BAAM SQUAD has been constantly evolving since its release of the first version on April 20. We recently made our 13th update and it means we've been updated the game at least twice a week! Sounds like a great workholic but yes, we believe this was possible thanks to the love and supports from you, the Steam, Viveport and Discord community people.

Looking back, our first month has been an incredible journey. We were extremely lucky to sold more copies than we gave away for free during our beta period, and Vivport loves us so much that it puts us into their featured sections for twice! Not only that, many of you also have left recorded or live streaming videos on Youtube and Twitch which triggered tens of thousands of viewers to get interest in BAAM SQUAD.

Nowadays, we are concentrating on making business deals with VR arcades around the world. This is not only to make our financial state better, but also to make BAAM SQUAD available to more potential users who has or hasn't own their VR headsets at home. Some of these deals are about to be inked soon, and we hope this to be our next tipping point to embrace more gamers to the community.

2. About the upcoming summer update
Beside our efforts on making VR arcade deals, with such potentials and achievements that BAAM SQUAD has been showing to us, we devs are very happy to take the next step forward to introduce you new features of the game.

As you all know, Steam and Viveport are going to have an annual summer sale during June. We are also going to give a -15% discount, but that's not simply all we would like to offer. We are actually working on to deliver you a major update and that's going to make the game even more excited! There will be three new big features available, and we are going to reveal each of these in our announcement every friday, PST. Please see below for detail.


 Week 1 (June 1) : Introducing New Zombies
 Week 2 (June 8) : Introducing New Weapons - Part 1
 Week 3 (June 15): Introducing New Weapons - Part 2
 Week 4 (June 22): Update will be available!


Please feel free to leave a comment on our Steam, Viveport and Discord channel regarding our update plan. Just like we've been doing so far, we will listen to you and the community to make BAAM SQUAD better and as fun as possible.


BAAM SQUAD TEAM.
